question: How much of Luxembourg's trade went both ways at chapter level, every five years from 2005 to 2025?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
3.6 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
WITH rows AS (
  SELECT
    year AS period,
    hs2 AS key,
    flow,
    hs2 LIKE '%X%' AS masked,
    value_eur
  FROM v_lu_trade
  WHERE
    period >= CAST('2005-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND (
      year - 2005
    ) % 5 = 0
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'export') AS x_total,
    SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'import') AS m_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      masked), 0) AS confidential
  FROM rows
  GROUP BY
    period
), by_key AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    key,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'export'), 0) AS x,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'import'), 0) AS m
  FROM rows
  WHERE
    NOT masked
  GROUP BY
    period,
    key
)
SELECT
  b.period,
  100 * SUM(b.x + b.m - ABS(b.x - b.m)) / SUM(b.x + b.m) AS value,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  ARG_MAX(b.key, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_key,
  ARG_MAX(b.x, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_export,
  ARG_MAX(b.m, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_import,
  ANY_VALUE(t.x_total) AS x_total,
  ANY_VALUE(t.m_total) AS m_total,
  ANY_VALUE(t.confidential) AS confidential
FROM by_key AS b
JOIN totals AS t
  USING (period)
GROUP BY
  b.period
ORDER BY
  b.period
LIMIT 10000
title: Two-way trade 2025: 68.8 % (chapter level)
insight: In 2025, 68.8 % of Luxembourg's trade was two-way at chapter level.
See the notes below for the data limits that apply.

facts.text: Two-way trade 2005 at chapter level: 74.0 % of trade; largest two-way chapter: Machinery and mechanical appliances (84), exports 4.13 bn €, imports 3.52 bn €
Two-way trade 2010 at chapter level: 69.3 % of trade; largest two-way chapter: Electrical machinery and equipment (85), exports 3.24 bn €, imports 2.13 bn €
Two-way trade 2015 at chapter level: 73.8 % of trade; largest two-way chapter: Electrical machinery and equipment (85), exports 2.92 bn €, imports 3.21 bn €
Two-way trade 2020 at chapter level: 67.9 % of trade; largest two-way chapter: Machinery and mechanical appliances (84), exports 1.63 bn €, imports 1.90 bn €
Two-way trade 2025 at chapter level: 68.8 % of trade; largest two-way chapter: Machinery and mechanical appliances (84), exports 2.04 bn €, imports 2.89 bn €
Largest two-way chapter by year: 2005 Machinery and mechanical appliances; 2010–2015 Electrical machinery and equipment; 2020–2025 Machinery and mechanical appliances
Two-way share of trade at chapter level: 74.0 % in 2005, 68.8 % in 2025; lowest 67.9 % in 2020, highest 74.0 % in 2005
